scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && biome check .
scripts.gen: uv run python -m townshiplens_api.export_openapi packages/api-client/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @tl/api-client gen
scripts.data:build: uv run python data/scripts/import_osm.py && uv run python data/scripts/build_overlay.py && uv run python data/scripts/build_flood.py && uv run python data/scripts/build_waste.py
scripts.data:city: uv run python data/scripts/build_buildings.py --max-requests 40 && uv run python data/scripts/build_buildings.py --parks --max-requests 40
scripts.db:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.existsSync('.data')?fs.readdirSync('.data'):[])if(/\.db(-wal|-shm)?$/.test(f))fs.rmSync('.data/'+f);console.log('local databases removed (stop the API first)')"
